name: Dr Adam Brownhill
title: Dr / GP
description: GP with over 25 years' clinical experience with a focus on gender-affirming care and long-term patient relationships; member of AusPATH, ASIAPATH and WPATH with peer-reviewed research in gender-affirming healthcare. TG Health Clinic provides individualised hormone therapy with ongoing monitoring based on informed consent, plus general practice care, in-clinic and via telehealth.
specialties: Gender affirming hormone therapy, gender-affirming primary care, general practice

name: Dr Sophea Ing
title: Dr / GP
description: I prescribe gender affirming hormone therapy to adults (18+) in line with the Australian Standards of Care for Informed Consent Gender-Affirming Hormone Therapy. You will not need to prove you are "trans enough" or "dysphoric enough". At capacity except for trans and gender diverse patients seeking gender affirming care; also gives testosterone injections and inserts oestradiol implants.
specialties: Gender affirming hormone therapy, oestradiol implants, mental health, student health, women's health, sexual health, PrEP, medical termination of pregnancy

name: Dr Michelle Dutton
title: Dr / GP
description: GP specialising in trans and gender diverse healthcare who has worked with the TGD community since 2014, including 10+ years at Northside Clinic, Equinox and Your Community Health; currently also part-time with the Orygen/headspace Trans and Gender Diverse team. Delivers and creates gender affirming care training for GPs. Prism Health is a telehealth service (postal address Drysdale, VIC).
specialties: Trans and gender diverse healthcare, gender affirming hormone therapy, GP education

name: Prof Darren Russell
title: Professor / Sexual health physician
description: Sexual health physician providing gender affirming hormonal care by telehealth under the AusPATH informed consent standards: no psychiatric assessment required for over-18s with capacity, usually over at least two longer appointments in conjunction with your GP. Also sees adolescents under WPATH and Australian paediatric standards (mental health assessment may be required under 18).
specialties: Gender affirming hormone therapy, adolescent gender affirming care, sexual health, HIV

name: Dr Jessie Rafeld
title: Dr / GP
description: GP accepting new patients, with special interests in LGBTQIA+ health, mental health, sexual health and adolescent health. Skills include gender affirming healthcare, PrEP prescribing, Implanon insertion/removal and medical termination of pregnancy.
specialties: Gender affirming healthcare, LGBTQIA+ health, sexual health, adolescent health, PrEP, MTOP

name: Dr Mathew Agnew
title: Dr / GP registrar
description: GP registrar with interests in holistic, trauma-informed care, mental health, and sexual and queer health; listed as a GP in the AusPATH trans health provider directory. Note: clinic has temporarily paused new patients, expecting to reopen in 2027.
specialties: Sexual and queer health, mental health, alcohol and other drugs

name: Dr Nicholas Silberstein
title: Dr / GP
practice: Equinox Gender Diverse Clinic (Thorne Harbour Health)
description: GP at Equinox, a general practice for trans and gender diverse people. Equinox GPs start, continue and manage gender-affirming hormone therapy using the Informed Consent Model, alongside general practice, sexual health and surgery referrals; GP appointments are bulk billed for Medicare card holders.
specialties: Gender affirming hormone therapy, trans and gender diverse primary care, sexual health

name: Mark Thompson
title: Nurse Practitioner (MNP, GCertSRH)
practice: Equinox Gender Diverse Clinic (Thorne Harbour Health)
description: Nurse practitioner at Equinox, Thorne Harbour Health's trans and gender diverse health service, listed in the AusPATH directory. Equinox provides gender-affirming hormone therapy under the Informed Consent Model with ongoing hormone management, monitoring and sexual health care; bulk billed for Medicare card holders.
specialties: Gender affirming hormone therapy, sexual and reproductive health

name: Equinox Gender Diverse Clinic
title: Clinic
description: General practice for trans and gender diverse people: start, continue or manage gender-affirming hormone therapy with an Equinox GP using the Informed Consent Model. Separate GP-referred endocrinology service helps adults 18+ initiate hormones (Fridays, in person or telehealth anywhere in Victoria). GP and endocrinologist appointments bulk billed for Medicare card holders.
specialties: Gender affirming hormone therapy, endocrinology, trans primary care, sexual health, PrEP

name: Dr Kateena Vogel
title: Dr / GP
description: GP committed to providing a safe and inclusive space regardless of gender identity or sexual orientation; an AusPATH member committed to strengthening the health, rights and wellbeing of binary and non-binary trans people. Wellness on Wellington provides gender affirming healthcare including access to hormone therapy and specialist referrals (call reception as a new patient).
specialties: Gender affirming care, preventative health, chronic disease, child health, sports medicine

name: Dr Bridget Fernando
title: Dr / GP
description: GP passionate about person-centred care with special interests in women's, adolescent and LGBTQIA+ health; listed as a GP in the AusPATH trans health provider directory.
specialties: LGBTQIA+ health, women's health, adolescent health

name: Dr Camilla Sleeth
title: Dr / GP
practice: Your Community Health - Trans and Gender Diverse Inclusive Care (TGDIC)
description: GP with Your Community Health's Victorian Government funded program providing specialist GP services for trans, gender diverse and non-binary people aged 18+, alongside peer navigation and allied health. Note: the program's GP service and waitlist are currently closed to new clients seeking gender affirming care.
specialties: Gender affirming care, trans and gender diverse health
